[[Category:Philosophy]]
'''Philosophy''', from Greek ''philosophia'', meaning the love of wisdom, is a discipline of [[humanities]] that seeks to understand the world via '''rational thinking'''.

== Branches ==

The main branches of philosophy includes:<ref>{{#cite:Q1834}}</ref>

* [[Metaphysics]], which studies the nature of reality,
* [[Epistemology]], which studies the nature and scope of knowledge
* Value theories, including
** [[Ethics]], which studies and evaluates human behaviour
** [[Aesthetics]], which studies the nature of beauty

== Philosophical methods ==

* [[Historical review]]
* [[Intuition]]
* [[Common sense]]
* [[Conceptual analysis]]
* [[Experimental philosophy]]
* [[Science]]
** Philosophy, especially branches like metaphysics and ethics, seeks to understand the nature of the world and human behaviour. Therefore, scientific discoveries in natural science, such as the structure of the universe and the electrochemical process underlying human thinking, can often help philosophers refine their perspectives.<ref>{{#cite:Q1837}}</ref>

* [[Logic]]
* [[Thought experiment]]
* [[Reflective equilibrium]]
* [[Critical analysis]]
